scripts.dev: npm run build && npx http-server www -p 8080 -c-1
scripts.test:workflow: MRT_SIGNING_SECRET=mrt-workflow-signing-secret MRT_SQUARE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=mrt-workflow-square-secret MRT_SQUARE_WEBHOOK_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5001/mrt-local-audit/us-central1/squareWebhook MRT_SQUARE_ACCESS_TOKEN=mock MRT_SQUARE_LOCATION_ID=mock MRT_INSTANTLY_API_KEY=mock MRT_INSTANTLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=mock MRT_TRANSACTIONAL_EMAIL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/mock MRT_TRANSACTIONAL_EMAIL_TOKEN=mock MRT_OUTBOUND_ALLOWLIST=agent@example.com npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project=mrt-local-audit --only auth,database,storage,functions "npm run seed:emu && node scripts/workflow-suite.mjs"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run validate
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath /tmp/mrt-ios-derived CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
